'''Yoss Paldamar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] who ran a small shop on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Operational Headquarters|Operational Headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paldamar appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Crew Skill Trade Vendor for Republic players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released alongside the game, identified him as "Yoss Paldamar."
